title: Finding
description: One finding of a review. The findings of a plan are one file, {"findings": [...]}. This file is the one authority on the fields, on their values and on who writes them: findings.py reads it at each run, and refuses to run when it holds a keyword that findings.py does not check.

id.description: r<round>-<lens>-<number>: the round and the lens given to add, then a number that the reviewer gives its findings from 1, with no leading zero. Example: r1-correctness-2.

file.description: The file that the finding is about, as a path relative to the root of the repository: it starts with neither / nor ~. Null when the finding is about no file.

line.description: The line of the file, from 1, or null. Always null when file is null.

severity.description: blocking: merged as it is, the change breaks a stated requirement or a behaviour that worked, or a check that it adds cannot fail for what it claims. major: a concrete scenario in which the change fails outside its main case: a context, a failure path, or a claim with no evidence. minor: it would not change the decision to merge. A reviewer whose own instructions use other grades applies these three: a demonstrated defect by these definitions, missing evidence as major, a remark as minor.

summary.description: What is wrong, in a sentence. At least one character that is not a space.

failure_scenario.description: The concrete input or state under which the change fails, and what then happens. At least one character that is not a space.

fix.description: What the reviewer proposes, not what was done. At least one character that is not a space.

lens.description: The lens of the review that found it, as given to add: a lower-case letter, then lower-case letters, digits and hyphens.

subject.description: What the finding is about: code, policy, carry-over or notes. An unsettled requirement is a finding of subject policy whose fix names the decision to take.

round_found.description: The review round that found it, from 1: the round given to add.

origin.description: Where the defect came from, as the codebook defines each value. Null until the coordinator has classified the finding.

disclosed_before_review.description: Whether the author had disclosed the defect before the review. Null until assessed.

disposition.description: What became of the finding. It is open when it is added; x-roles says which role may then set which value.

carry_over_of.description: The id of the finding of an earlier round that this one carries over, or null.
